clue.text: Maybe Ali G dined in at leisure

indicators.note: in tells us the eating word sits inside the word for leisure

parts.note: leisure time is rest
dined means ate

explanation.surface: A joke about the comic character Ali G taking a relaxed meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ali G' looks like one name, but Ali is the definition, Muhammad Ali's self-chosen nickname, and the G stands alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Boxer Muhammad Ali called himself The Greatest, so he is one example of someone known by that nickname.

clue.text: Contact every redhead in advance

indicators.note: in advance says the first piece goes in front of the second

parts.note: the head (first letter) of red
every means each

explanation.surface: An instruction to get in touch with each ginger-haired person beforehand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redhead' is one word but means the first letter of 'red', and 'in advance' puts it in front of EACH.
explanation.definitionFit: To reach someone is to get through to them by phone or message, a synonym for contacting them.

clue.text: Active Resistance lines illuminated fortress's defensive feature

parts.note: A is the grammar abbreviation for active
R is the physics symbol for resistance
lines of seats or plants are rows
illuminated means lit

explanation.surface: Defenders firing lines of light from a castle's walls.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrow slit is the narrow vertical opening in castle walls through which archers shot, a defensive detail of fortifications.

clue.text: Avoids key man with square head

parts.note: Esc is the escape key on a computer keyboard
a man is referred to as he

indicators.note: head says the first letter of square is taken

explanation.surface: Someone dodges an important man whose head is block-shaped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'key man' reads as an important person, but 'key' is the computer's escape key and 'man' a pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: To eschew something is to deliberately stay away from or shun it, a formal synonym of avoids.

clue.text: New comet exploding with sweets squeezing space-time as subject of two 6dn films

indicators.note: an exploding comet is blown apart, so its letters with the N are rearranged
squeezing says the sweets hold the space-time pieces inside them

parts.note: M&M's are sweets, written as M AND MS
an en is a printer's unit of space

explanation.surface: A sci-fi scene: a comet blowing up while sweets crush the fabric of space-time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exploding' makes TENCOM; 'squeezing' wraps the sweets round space and time. DeMille filmed the story in 1923 and 1956.
explanation.definitionFit: Cecil B. DeMille directed both the silent and the 1956 epic versions of the Biblical commandments story.

clue.text: Work out how one would remove Mussolini?

parts.note: the prefix de- means remove, as in delouse
Mussolini was called Il Duce, the leader

explanation.surface: A question about how you would get rid of the Italian dictator.
explanation.walkthrough: Like delousing, 'de-Duce' would mean removing the Duce, Mussolini's title.
explanation.definitionFit: To deduce is to reason a conclusion out from evidence, which is what working something out means.

clue.text: River swallows works of film-maker

indicators.note: a river that swallows something takes it inside, so one word goes within the other

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
a mill is a works or factory

explanation.surface: A river engulfing the work of a director.
explanation.definitionFit: Cecil B. DeMille was the Hollywood director of Biblical epics, so he is a film-maker.

clue.text: Follow master's doctrinal writings

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them closely
an MA is a master's degree

explanation.surface: Studying a teacher's writings on doctrine.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogma is the set of beliefs laid down by a church or authority, the content of doctrinal teaching.

clue.text: 6dn film about pole-dancing by ambassador back after vacation

parts.note: C is short for circa, about

indicators.note: dancing moves the letters of pole around

parts.note: by can mean at, as in at the door

indicators.note: back says the pair of letters is read the other way
after vacation the word ambassador is emptied of all but its outer letters

explanation.surface: A racy film about pole-dancing, set next to an ambassador returning from holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pole-dancing' reads as one activity but 'dancing' is the anagram signal; 'after vacation' empties the ambassador and 'back' turns the remaining pair round.
explanation.definitionFit: DeMille directed the 1934 picture about the Egyptian queen, one of his films.

clue.text: Just force to broadcast

parts.note: F is the physics abbreviation for force
to air a programme is to broadcast it

explanation.surface: An order simply to make something go out on air.
explanation.definitionFit: Just and fair both describe treatment that is impartial and right.

clue.text: One who appreciates 6dn building cage in Rome

indicators.note: building puts the letters together in a new structure

explanation.surface: A Roman construction project putting up a cage.
explanation.definitionFit: A filmgoer is the sort of person who would enjoy DeMille's movies.

clue.text: Please demonstrate how Chalmie succeeded earlier

indicators.note: earlier says the succeeded letter goes before the rest

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees
the setter Chalmie refers to himself as me

explanation.surface: A request for the setter to show how earlier success was achieved.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter's name stands for ME, the setter speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an imperative request to have something shown or proved, politely asking for a demonstration.

clue.text: Lights reflecting special row of shops on satellite

indicators.note: reflecting, as in a mirror, sends the whole string back the other way

parts.note: a mall is a row of shops
Io is a moon of Jupiter

explanation.surface: A shopping street on a moon, lit up and reflected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflecting' turns SP + MALL + IO back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: Oil lamps are old-fashioned lights burning oil through a wick.

clue.text: Slam slum demolished for widow's mite?

indicators.note: a demolished building is knocked to pieces, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: Knocking down poor housing in a sudden act.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as an example: the widow in the Gospels gave two mites.
explanation.definitionFit: The widow's mite in the Bible was a tiny coin offering, so it exemplifies a trifling amount of money.

clue.text: Creepy-crawly 6dn exchanging parts accepting 13

indicators.note: accepting means the swapped name takes the small sum inside it
the two halves of the name swap places

parts.note: the answer to 6 down, the film-maker DeMille
the answer to 13 across, a small sum, here 1p, one penny

explanation.surface: A bug, linked to the director, swapping pieces about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchanging parts' makes DE MILLE into MILLE DE; 'accepting' takes in 1P, read as IP.
explanation.definitionFit: A millipede is a many-legged arthropod, the sort of creature people call a creepy-crawly.

clue.text: Former fall-guy cut off by Costa del Crime Brits?

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: cut off removes the last letter of the word

parts.note: a patsy is a fall-guy, someone set up to take blame

explanation.surface: A one-time scapegoat shut out by British criminals living in Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: The Costa del Crime is a jokey name for Spain's Costa del Sol, where some British crooks settled.
explanation.definitionFit: Expats are people living abroad; Britons on the Spanish coast are an example, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Kansas resident maybe describing mains rerouting with diagram

indicators.note: describing, in the sense of drawing round, puts the plan around the rest

parts.note: a plan is a diagram

indicators.note: rerouting sends the letters of mains along a new path

explanation.surface: A Kansan drawing a diagram of re-laid water mains.
explanation.definitionFit: Kansas lies on the Great Plains, so someone living there could be called a dweller of the plains.

clue.text: Reluctant to intervene in company's fate

indicators.note: to intervene in is to come between, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
loth means reluctant

explanation.surface: A firm's destiny when someone declines to step in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fate' has a lower-case f in the surface but means one of the three Fates.
explanation.definitionFit: Clotho was one of the three Fates of Greek myth, the one who spun the thread of life.

clue.text: A mythical king leaving old city for venue of 6dn's 1 11 without me

parts.note: a means one

indicators.note: leaving says the old city departs from the king's name

parts.note: King Arthur is the legendary British king
Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A legendary king quitting an ancient city for somewhere new.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 11 without me is GREATEST SHOW, so the definition points to DeMille's The Greatest Show on Earth.
explanation.definitionFit: DeMille's 1952 circus film was titled The Greatest Show on Earth, so the phrase names the venue.

clue.text: On flat, an accident is survivable

indicators.note: an accident throws things into disorder, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A mishap in a flat that someone lives through.
explanation.definitionFit: Something non-fatal does not kill, so it can be lived through.

clue.text: Lacking travel document, departs Serbian city

parts.note: with no visa you lack the travel document
D is the abbreviation for departs, as on timetables

explanation.surface: A traveller without the right papers leaves a city in Serbia.
explanation.definitionFit: Novi Sad is the second-largest city in Serbia, on the Danube.

clue.text: Flooring mule, lion is frenzied

indicators.note: frenzied animals thrash about, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Two animals running wild across the floor.
explanation.definitionFit: Linoleum is a hard-wearing sheet floor covering, a kind of flooring.

clue.text: Starts work endlessly tense

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

indicators.note: endlessly means the outer letters of the word tense are dropped

explanation.surface: A nervous start to an unending job.
explanation.definitionFit: Opens and starts both mean begins, as when a play or shop begins business.

clue.text: Base in very pleasant city

indicators.note: in places the base letter within the other pieces

parts.note: nice means pleasant
e is the base of natural logarithms

explanation.surface: Living somewhere very nice.
explanation.definitionFit: Venice is the Italian city built on lagoon islands.

clue.text: Fellow doctor to break one of the 5

parts.note: co- marks a fellow, as in co-worker
a vet is an animal doctor

explanation.surface: A colleague and a doctor breaking a commandment together.
explanation.walkthrough: 5 is the TEN COMMANDMENTS; 'Thou shalt not covet' is one of them.
explanation.definitionFit: Coveting a neighbour's goods is forbidden by the Decalogue, so coveting is breaking one of those laws.

clue.text: Predators could make peer resign

indicators.note: could make says the letters can be made into something new

explanation.surface: Political predators that might force a lord to quit.
explanation.definitionFit: Peregrines are falcons that hunt other birds, so they are predators.

clue.text: Propose kicking out independent film

indicators.note: kicking out removes a letter from the film word

parts.note: a film is a movie

explanation.surface: Suggesting an indie film be thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: To move a motion at a meeting is to formally propose it.

clue.text: Very decent American specimens change in part

indicators.note: in part says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A fine American whose samples are altered.
explanation.definitionFit: Mensch, American slang from Yiddish, is a person of integrity and honour, a thoroughly good sort.

clue.text: Additional comment study circle put in place

indicators.note: put in places the study and circle pieces inside the place word

parts.note: a site is a place
a den is a study
O is circle-shaped

explanation.surface: A study group adding a remark where it belongs.
explanation.definitionFit: A side note is a supplementary remark set beside the main text.
